description: Runs the README's translator adapters against the real libraries they document. Kept out of the root manifest so the library itself takes no translation dependency — the whole point of the seam being a plain callable. Versions are pinned exactly, for the reason tools/psr7-readme pins its own: composer.lock is gitignored repo-wide, and a check that reads code out of README.md should not fail on somebody else's release. `composer translator-readme` runs `update` rather than `install` because the library is installed from a path repository, so a change to its own autoload configuration only reaches this vendor directory when the package is re-resolved.
